rows.grounds: compound adjective in nominative singular masculine
comparative particle vat attached to shiva

items.question: What status does the worshipper attain on earth?
premises: The devotee is worshipped by all worlds.
items.inference: Thus the devotee becomes Shiva-like and earth-dwelling.
uncertainties: Exact internal sandhi of sarvalokaikasaṃpūjyaḥ is not split.
items.plain_english: Worshipped by all worlds like Shiva, he dwells on earth.
